'''Deirdre Longacher Smeltzer''' (born 1964){{r|born}} is an American mathematician, [[mathematics education|mathematics educator]], textbook author, and academic administrator. A former professor, dean, and vice president at [[Eastern Mennonite University]], she is Senior Director for Programs at the [[Mathematical Association of America]].{{r|maa}}

==Education and career==
Smeltzer was a mathematics major at Eastern Mennonite University, graduating in 1987 with a minor in Bible study. At Eastern Mennonite, mathematicians Millard Showalter and Del Snyder became faculty mentors, encouraging her to continue in advanced mathematics.{{r|vpdean}} She went on to graduate study in mathematics at the [[University of Virginia]], earning a master's degree{{r|vpdean}} and completing her Ph.D. in 1994, with the dissertation ''Topics in Difference Sets in 2-Groups'' on [[difference set]]s in [[group theory]], supervised by Harold Ward.{{r|mg}}

She became a faculty member at the [[University of St. Thomas (Minnesota)|University of St. Thomas]], a Catholic university in [[Saint Paul, Minnesota]],{{r|vpdean|mutual}} before returning to Eastern Mennonite University as a faculty member in 1998.{{r|mutual}}  She chaired the mathematical sciences department from 2005 to 2012.{{r|vpdean}}
As an undergraduate at Eastern Mennonite, she had participated in a cross-cultural visit to China,{{r|mutual}} and as a faculty member, she led another such visit in 2013,{{r|mutual|china}} and became director of cross-cultural programs for the university. In 2013, she was named the university's vice president and undergraduate dean.{{r|vpdean}}
In that position, she led the university's creation of new programs in political science and global studies,{{r|launch}} among others.{{r|mutual}}

She stepped down from her administrative positions at Eastern Mennonite in 2019,{{r|mutual}} and joined the [[Mathematical Association of America]] as Senior Director for Programs in 2020.{{r|maa}}

==Textbooks==
Smeltzer is the coauthor of two undergraduate textbooks in mathematics: ''Methods for Euclidean Geometry'' (with Owen Byer and Felix Lazebnik, Mathematical Association of America, 2010){{r|meg}} and ''Journey into Discrete Mathematics'' (with Owen Byer and Kenneth Wantz, MAA Press, 2018).{{r|jdm}}
